items.name: Pilau (Swahili Beef Pilau)
items.description: Authentic aromatic pilau rice cooked with tender beef chunks, cumin, garlic and cardamom, served with fresh spicy kachumbari.

items.name: Chicken 1/4 (Quarter Chicken)
items.description: Crispy seasoned quarter chicken, fried golden brown with crunchy skin and juicy, flavorful meat inside. Pairs great with Fries or Pilau.

items.name: Fries Masala
items.description: Golden hand-cut potato chips smothered in a sizzling hot tomato, onion, and chili masala gravy with lemon and chopped cilantro.

items.name: Fries (Chips)
items.description: Crisp, golden-fried Kenyan potato chips lightly salted and served hot in generous portions with tomato ketchup and chili sauce.

items.name: Samosa
items.description: Crispy, flaky triangular pastry pocket stuffed with well-seasoned minced meat, onions, cumin, and chopped coriander.

items.name: Uji Power
items.description: Nairobi's legendary thick, nutritious multigrain porridge infused with ground pumpkin seeds, nuts, and natural honey sweetness.

items.name: Mandazi (Andazi)
items.description: Soft, fluffy, golden-brown East African sweet fried bread pastry infused with aromatic cardamom. Perfect companion for chai or uji.

items.name: Fruit Juice
items.description: Freshly blended chilled tropical fruit juice: Mango, Passion, Pineapple or Orange without artificial sweeteners or preservatives.

items.name: Fruit Salad
items.description: Crisp medley of freshly diced watermelon, sweet pineapple, pawpaw, and crisp apple cubes tossed in natural fruit nectar.

items.name: Soda 350ml
items.description: Crisp ice-cold 350ml soda bottle. Choose Coca-Cola, Fanta Orange, Fanta Blackcurrant, Sprite, or Stoney Tangawizi.

items.name: Soda 500ml
items.description: Refreshing 500ml PET bottle served super chilled. Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite, Krest Bitter Lemon, or Stoney Tangawizi.

items.name: Sausages
items.description: Crispy fried sausages, served steaming hot with fresh pilipili.

items.name: Smokies
items.description: Classic flavored smokie, deep fried golden and served crisp.

items.name: Chapatis
items.description: Soft, flaky, hand-made chapatis — fresh off the pan.

items.name: Tea
items.description: Hot spiced Kenyan chai brewed fresh with milk and spices.

items.name: Choma Sausages
items.description: Smoky charcoal-grilled sausages with our special choma glaze.
